args.title: Issue 4406: change src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In src/ingest/parser.ts, parseStatement splits input by newlines and removes one final empty string if the file ends with a newline, but if there are multiple trailing blank lines or subtle whitespace issues, it can cause one line with incorrect column count. The assertShape function throws 'Malformed row' if columns do not match header, explaining the failure on the last blank line row.
